directive: Revise only `oeq:studentized-uniform-projection` and its sampling notation. Define deterministic sequences \(n_s(n),n_t(n)\) with \(n_s(n)+n_t(n)=n\), \(n\to\infty\), and \(n_s(n)/n\to p\in(0,1)\); index the two samples, empirical moments, and confidence set accordingly. State uniform coverage explicitly as \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{\mathbb M\in\mathcal A_p}P_{\mathcal M_n}\{\theta_{x,y,n}\in\widehat C^{\mathrm{SAR}}_{x,y,n,1-\alpha}\}\ge1-\alpha\), where \(\mathcal A_p\) retains exactly the stated target-span, changing-rank, singular-covariance, and diverging-balancing-weight allowances. Require \(O_P(n^{-1/2})\) diameter and the regular Wald limit only on fixed strongly identified submodels under this allocation regime. Do not alter the causal claims, structural assumptions, converse, witness, or finite-sample concentration theorem.

Preserve every causal assumption, identification claim, converse, perturbation, and rational witness. Keep \(P_{\mathcal M}\) as the source full-data law; define \(\mathbb P_{\mathcal M}^{\,n_s,n_t}:=P_O^{\otimes n_s}\otimes b^{\otimes n_t}\), and replace Theorem 3's probability by \(\mathbb P_{\mathcal M}^{\,n_s,n_t}\{\theta_{x,y}\in\widehat C_{x,y,1-\alpha}\}\), updating symbols/free-symbols and the sampling-model text consistently. For \(1\le r_0\le\min(m,|\mathcal E|)\) and fixed \(c,\eta>0\), define the strongly identified submodel \(\mathcal R_{r_0,c,\eta}\) by \(\operatorname{rank}(H_x)=r_0\), \(\sigma_{r_0}(H_x)\ge c\), \(b\in\operatorname{col}(H_x)\), \(z_{x,y}\in\operatorname{row}(H_x)\), all source and target cells at least \(\eta\), and positive delta-method variance at least \(\eta\). Define \(\phi_{r_0}(H,z,b)=z^\top H_{r_0}^{\dagger}b\) and \(\widehat\theta^{\,W}_{x,y,n}=\phi_{r_0}(\widehat H_{x,n},\widehat z_{x,y,n},\widehat b_n)\), where \(H_{r_0}\) is the rank-\(r_0\) truncated-SVD matrix; let \(\widehat V_n\) be the plug-in delta-method variance using the joint source multinomial covariance and target multinomial covariance with allocation factors \(p^{-1}\) and \((1-p)^{-1}\), and define \(I^W_{n,1-\alpha}=[\widehat\theta^{\,W}_{x,y,n}\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\widehat V_n/n}]\cap[0,1]\). Define \(\operatorname{diam}_2(C)=\sup_{u,v\in C}|u-v|\) (and 0 for empty \(C\)) and use Euclidean Hausdorff distance \(d_H\). Replace the regular-branch clause by the determinate requirement, for every fixed \(\mathcal R_{r_0,c,\eta}\), \(\operatorname{diam}_2(\widehat C^{\mathrm{SAR}}_{x,y,n,1-\alpha})=O_P(n^{-1/2})\) and \(\sqrt n\,d_H(\widehat C^{\mathrm{SAR}}_{x,y,n,1-\alpha},I^W_{n,1-\alpha})\to_P0\).
